note: Proof skeleton: choose a trail with the maximum possible number of edges. Endpoint parity forces it closed. If it omits an edge, connectedness gives an unused edge incident with a vertex on the trail. Delete trail edges: every residual degree is even because a closed trail uses an even number of incident edges at each vertex. Starting at that vertex, take a maximal residual trail; endpoint parity makes it a nonempty closed trail. Splice at the shared vertex to obtain a strictly longer trail, contradiction.
